local({
  freq <- cbind(
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.a1), 6 - as.numeric(b001.a1)),
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.a2), 6 - as.numeric(b001.a2)),
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.a3), 6 - as.numeric(b001.a3))
  )
  viol <- cbind(
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.b1), 4 - as.numeric(b001.b1)),
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.b2), 4 - as.numeric(b001.b2)),
    coalesce(as.numeric(q001.b3), 4 - as.numeric(b001.b3))
  )
  freq[!freq %in% 1:5] <- NA
  viol[!viol %in% 0:3] <- NA
  products <- freq * viol
  rated <- rowSums(!is.na(products))
  answered <- rowSums(!is.na(freq) | !is.na(viol))
  rebuilt <- if_else(rated > 0, rowSums(products, na.rm = TRUE) / pmax(rated, 1), NA_real_)
  score <- if_else(wave == "2", rebuilt, as.numeric(child_VTV_ind))
  if_else(rated >= answered / 2, score, NA_real_)
})
